test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

I saw a shabby looking man living in the __cavity __of a mountain.
solution:
The correct answer is: **hole**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cavity"** means an empty space within a solid object, often referring to a hollow area. (गुहा)

 
 
• **Example: **The dentist found a cavity in one of my molars during the check-up.
 
 
 
• **"hole"** refers to an opening or hollow space in something, which is similar to the meaning of cavity. (छेद)
 
 
• **Example: **The rabbit disappeared into a hole in the ground.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to replace 'cavity' is 'hole'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **hole**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Elevation** (उन्नति): The height above a given level, especially sea level.

 
 
• **Example:** The elevation of the mountain peak is over 8,000 meters.
 
 
 
• **Height** (ऊंचाई): The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.
 
 
• **Example:** The height of the tower is 100 meters.
 
 
 
• **Mound** (ढेर): A raised area of earth or stones.
 
 
• **Example:** They built a small mound of stones as a marker.
